remarks: Space! Over 2,300 sq/ft of combined finished living space!  Nestled at the end of a cul-de-sac in sought-after Wolfpit, this fully updated single-family home offers modern comfort and charm. Freshly painted with hardwood floors throughout, it's move-in ready!  The spacious kitchen features quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, and a second oven, perfect for cooking and entertaining. A dining room flows into the family room with a fireplace and vaulted ceilings, leading to a deck and fenced backyard with plenty of play space.    The primary suite boasts three closets and an updated bathroom, while two well-sized bedrooms and another full bath complete the main level.    The fully finished basement adds incredible flexibility-ideal for a media room, play area, or gym. It includes a bonus room (4th bedroom/office), full bath, and laundry room with storage. This level can perfectly serve as a private suite if needed.    Electric car charger installed!    With modern updates, ample space, and a prime location, this Wolfpit rental won't last! Available immediately-schedule a tour today!
